_how_to_edit: Each zone is a rectangle: min_lat/max_lat (south-north) and min_lng/max_lng (west-east). Keep rectangles adjacent (they should not overlap) and cover the streets you test on. id is what gets stored on complaints; name is what everyone sees in the UI.
